DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。ご相談の内容を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Please tell me what you would like to discuss.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 知らない人から何件も電話が来たと話しましたが、番号を見ると同じ番号からの着信でした。相手の人数と着信回数を混ぜずに説明し直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 複数着信を複数人と表現したが同番号で説明を直したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I said that I had received several calls from strangers, but when I checked the numbers, all the calls were from the same number. I would like to explain it again without confusing the number of callers with the number of calls.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you described several incoming calls as calls from several people, but they came from the same number, and you want to correct your explanation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 着信は何回で、表示された番号は何種類ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: How many calls were there, and how many different numbers were displayed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 五回で、番号は一種類です。同じ番号でも誰がかけたかは分かりません。一人とも五人とも断定できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 五回一種類番号で一人か五人かは断定できないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: There were five calls and only one number. Even though the number was the same, I do not know who called. I cannot say for certain whether it was one person or five people.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Answer that there were five calls from one number, and you cannot determine whether there was one caller or five. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 相手と会話はしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Did you speak to the caller?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一度も出ていません。知らない番号だということと、相手が何を言ったかは別で、発言内容はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一度も応答せず発言内容はないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I did not answer any of the calls. Knowing that the number is unfamiliar is different from knowing what the caller said; I have no statements from them to report.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you never answered, so there is nothing the caller said that you can report. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 履歴を残しておいてください。着信時刻は確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please keep the call history. Can you check the times of the calls?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 履歴に時刻があります。記憶で「一日中」とまとめず、五回それぞれの時刻を示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 各時刻を履歴で示し一日中と記憶でまとめないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: The times are in the call history. Instead of relying on my memory and describing it as “all day,” I will show the time of each of the five calls.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Answer that you will show each time from the call history instead of summarizing it from memory as “all day.” Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。今後どう対応するかも、状況を伺って相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Thank you. We can also discuss how to respond going forward after hearing about the situation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。回数、表示番号、応答していないことを伝えます。相手の意図や人数を自分で付け加えず、まず今ある履歴を残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 回数番号未応答を示し意図人数を加えず履歴を保存すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, please. I will report the number of calls, the number displayed, and the fact that I did not answer. I will first preserve the existing call history without adding my own assumptions about the callers' intentions or how many people there were.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that you will report the call count, number, and unanswered status, and save the history without adding assumptions about intentions or the number of people. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 五回の着信と一種類の番号、応答していないことを確認しました。履歴はそのまま残してください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have confirmed five calls from one number and that you did not answer. Please leave the call history as it is. Thank you for coming to discuss this.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何をお送りになる予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What are you planning to send?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 資料と返信用の封筒を送ります。ただ、返信で戻してほしい物と、相手に残してほしい物が混ざらないように準備したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 送付資料と返信用封筒で残す物と戻す物を混ぜず準備したいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am sending some documents and a return envelope. However, I want to prepare them so that the items I would like returned are not confused with the items I want the recipient to keep.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about preparing documents and a return envelope while keeping the items to be kept and returned clearly separate. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの資料を戻してもらう予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which documents are you planning to have returned?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 記入した申込書は相手に残し、見本の写真だけ返してほしいです。返信用封筒を入れるから全部戻るという意味ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 申込書は相手保管で写真だけ返送希望と区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I want the recipient to keep the completed application form and return only the sample photograph. Including a return envelope does not mean that I want everything sent back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the distinction: the recipient should keep the application form, and you only want the photograph returned. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その希望は、相手への説明に書いてありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Have you written those wishes in your explanation to the recipient?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだ書いていません。窓口に説明するだけでは相手に伝わらないので、同封のメモに書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 窓口への口頭説明だけでなく相手向けメモを書くと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Not yet. Merely explaining it at this counter will not tell the recipient, so I will write it in an enclosed note.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Answer that you will write a note for the recipient, rather than only explaining it verbally at the counter. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 相手がその対応をするかは、事前に確認してください。封筒に入れる物は整理できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check in advance whether the recipient will do that. Can you organize the items to go in the envelope?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。申込書、写真、説明メモ、返信用封筒です。写真は封筒に収まりますが、返送を頼めるかは相手へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同封四点を列挙し写真返送対応は相手へ確認すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. They are the application form, the photograph, the explanatory note, and the return envelope. The photograph fits in the envelope, but I will check with the recipient whether I can ask them to return it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: List the four enclosed items and say that you will check with the recipient about returning the photograph. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この窓口では、相手が何を返すかは約束できません。発送方法の相談はできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We cannot promise at this counter what the recipient will return. We can advise you on how to send the items.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。返送の合意を先に確かめ、送る物の一覧と戻してほしい写真を区別してから発送を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 返送合意を確かめ資料一覧と写真返送希望を区別して発送相談すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I understand. I will first confirm their agreement to return the photograph, distinguish the list of items being sent from the photograph I want returned, and then ask about sending them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Answer that you will confirm the return agreement, distinguish the list of documents from the request to return the photograph, and then ask about sending them. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 写真だけの返送を希望され、相手への確認と説明メモを先に整える形ですね。発送のご相談はその後に承ります。本日のご確認ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: You would like only the photograph returned, and will first check with the recipient and prepare an explanatory note. We can discuss sending the items after that. Thank you for checking with us today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。本日のご相談は何でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to discuss today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家計について話したいのですが、近くに知人がいます。金額を声に出す前に、もう少し話が聞こえにくい場所で相談できるか伺いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 近くに知人がいて家計額を話す前に聞こえにくい相談場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to discuss my household finances, but someone I know is nearby. Before saying any amounts aloud, I would like to ask whether we can speak somewhere where our conversation is less likely to be overheard.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that someone you know is nearby, and ask about a less easily overheard place before discussing household amounts. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 使える場所を確認します。今は詳しい内容をお話しにならなくて大丈夫です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check what space is available. You do not need to explain the details right now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。知人を避けるために別の金額を言うのではなく、話せる方法を先に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 聞かれたくないため偽額を言わず話せる方法を確認したいと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Thank you. Rather than giving a different amount to avoid being overheard by that person, I would first like to check how I can discuss this.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Answer that you do not want to give a false amount to avoid being overheard, and want to check how you can talk about it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今は個室が空いていません。内容をメモで示す方法なら使えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: There is no private room available right now. You can show the information in a note instead.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、必要な数字をメモにします。机の端へ広げず、担当の方だけが読めるようにお渡ししたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 個室がないので数字メモを担当だけへ示したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will write down the necessary figures. Rather than spreading the note out at the edge of the desk, I would like to hand it over so that only the person handling my consultation can read it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Since there is no private room, ask to show a note with the figures only to the staff member handling your consultation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認後のメモを、手元へ戻すこともできます。ご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can also return the note to you after checking it. Would you like that?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、持ち帰ります。使い終わった紙をそのまま机に置かず、受け取ってしまいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 確認後メモを持帰り机に残さないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, I will take it home. I will take the paper back and put it away rather than leaving it on the desk after use.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Answer that you will take the note home after it is checked and will not leave it on the desk. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今日はメモで相談し、さらに詳しい話が必要なら別の方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will use a note for today's consultation, and if a more detailed discussion is needed, we will explain another way to proceed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。聞かれたくないから説明を省いたまま終えるのでなく、今日はメモで話し、必要な続きは案内を受けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 内容省略で終えずメモ相談し続きの方法は案内を受けたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, please. Rather than ending the consultation with details left out because I do not want to be overheard, I will use a note today and receive guidance on any necessary follow-up.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that you do not want to finish with information omitted, and would like to consult using a note and receive guidance on further discussion. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 今日は必要な数字をメモで示し、確認後はお持ち帰りになるご希望を承りました。ここでの金額の声出しは控え、メモで進める担当へおつなぎします。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I understand that you would like to show the necessary figures in a note today and take it home after we check it. We will avoid saying the amounts aloud here and connect you with the staff member who can proceed using the note. Thank you for your consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。贈り物をお探しでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. Are you looking for a gift?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: お世話になった三人へ同じお茶を贈りたいです。この箱を三つそろえて、それぞれ包んでいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 三人へ同じ茶を贈るため三箱をそろえて個別包装を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to give the same tea to three people who have helped me. Could you provide three of this box and wrap each one separately?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for three boxes of the same tea for three people, with each box wrapped separately. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらのお茶は今、二箱だけです。三箱そろう別のお茶も見てみますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: We only have two boxes of this tea right now. Would you like to look at another tea that we have three boxes of?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。一人だけ違う物にするより、三人とも同じ商品にしたいので、別のお茶から選び直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二箱しかない最初の商品をやめ三箱そろう別の茶を見たいと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, please. I would rather give all three people the same product than give one person something different, so I will choose a different tea.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Answer that you will leave the first product because only two boxes are available and would like to see another tea with three boxes available. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらは三箱あります。一箱五百円で、個別の包装は一つ百円です。ご予算はいくらでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We have three boxes of this one. Each box is 500 yen, and individual wrapping is 100 yen per gift. What is your budget?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 包装も入れて二千円までです。このお茶を三箱にすると商品代が千五百円で、包装三つが三百円なので、合計千八百円ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 包装込み予算二千円以内で商品千五百円と包装三百円の合計千八百円を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Up to 2,000 yen including wrapping. Three boxes of this tea would cost 1,500 yen, and wrapping all three would cost 300 yen, so the total is 1,800 yen, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm a total of 1,800 yen: 1,500 yen for the tea and 300 yen for wrapping, within a budget of 2,000 yen including wrapping. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、千八百円です。三つとも同じ紙で包めます。お渡し用の袋も三枚必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, 1,800 yen. We can wrap all three in the same paper. Do you also need three gift bags?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一枚だけお願いします。配る場所まで三つをまとめて運びますが、包装は開かず一つずつ渡したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 包装は三つだが運ぶ袋は一枚だけほしいと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Just one bag, please. I will carry the three together to where I will hand them out, but I want to give them individually without opening the wrapping.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Answer that there are three wrapped gifts, but you only want one bag to carry them. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。包装には価格の分かるシールを残さないようにします。レシートはお客様にお渡ししてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Certainly. We will make sure no price stickers remain on the wrapping. May I give the receipt to you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、レシートは私が受け取り、贈り物の中へ入れないでください。三箱を別々に包み、一枚の袋へまとめる形でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: レシートは贈り物に入れず自分が受け取り三箱を別々に包んで一袋にまとめてほしいと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, I will take the receipt; please do not put it inside any of the gifts. Please wrap the three boxes separately and put them together in one bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Answer that you will take the receipt rather than put it in a gift, and ask for three separately wrapped boxes together in one bag. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 同じお茶を三箱、個別包装して一枚の袋にまとめます。合計千八百円で、レシートは別にお渡しします。ご注文ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will individually wrap three boxes of the same tea and put them in one bag. The total is 1,800 yen, and we will give you the receipt separately. Thank you for your order.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。公園内の道でお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Are you having trouble finding your way around the park?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 地図の上の方へ行けば遊具に着くと思いましたが、今向いている前方とは違うようです。北の方向と自分の向きを合わせたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 地図上方向を自分前方と誤解し北と自身の向きを合わせたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought I could reach the playground equipment by heading toward the top of the map, but that seems to be different from the direction I am facing. I would like to align north with my own orientation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you mistook the top of the map for the direction in front of you, and want to align north with the direction you are facing. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この地図は上が北です。今、ご自分はどちらを向いているか分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: North is at the top of this map. Do you know which direction you are facing now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 方向はまだ分かりません。案内板に向かって立っているので、板の上を自分の前だと考えていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 案内板に向いており実方位は不明で上を前と思ったと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I do not know yet. I am standing facing the information board, so I had thought of the top of the board as the direction in front of me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Answer that you are facing the information board, do not know the actual compass direction, and thought the top meant forward. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現在地と近くの池を見比べましょう。池は今、あなたのどちら側ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's compare your current location with the nearby pond. Which side of you is the pond on now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 左側です。地図では現在地の右側に池があるので、私の立つ向きと地図の向きが逆だと分かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 池は左だが図で右のため地図と立つ向きが逆と照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: On my left. On the map, the pond is to the right of my current location, so I can see that the direction I am facing is opposite to the map's orientation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Compare the pond being on your left with it being on the right on the map, and explain that your orientation is reversed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今は地図の南側へ向いているので、北はご自身の後ろ側です。遊具は現在地の北側にあります。行きたいのは池ではなく遊具ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: You are facing south on the map, so north is behind you. The playground equipment is north of your current location. You want to go to the playground equipment, not the pond, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、遊具です。目印として池を使いましたが、池へ向かう道を探しているわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 池は位置確認の目印で目的地は遊具と区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, the playground equipment. I used the pond as a landmark, but I am not looking for a path to the pond.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish the pond as a landmark for checking your position from the playground equipment as your destination. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 案内板から少し離れて後ろ側へ向き直り、北側へ続く通路をお進みください。次の分かれ道で遊具の表示を確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Step a little away from the information board, turn around, and follow the path going north. You can check the sign for the playground equipment at the next fork.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。地図の上へまっすぐという覚え方をやめ、通路と次の案内を確認します。位置を確かめる目印と目的地も区別します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 図上へ直進と覚えず通路と案内を見て目印と目的地を分けると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I understand. I will stop thinking of it as simply going straight toward the top of the map and check the path and the next sign. I will also distinguish the landmark used to check my position from my destination.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Answer that you will check the path and signs instead of remembering it as straight toward the top, and distinguish the landmark from the destination. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 遊具へは向き直って北側の通路を進み、分かれ道の表示を確かめる経路ですね。池は方向を合わせる目印として使えました。足元にお気を付けて、どうぞ行ってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07208-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: To reach the playground equipment, turn around, take the northbound path, and check the sign at the fork. The pond helped you align your direction. Watch your step, and have a good visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. May I help you with something?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自分の旅行予定を書いた紙を忘れました。予定通りの列車が分からないので、紙に書いた内容を放送で呼びかけてもらおうかと考えています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 忘れた予定紙の内容を放送で尋ねようと考え列車を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I left behind the paper with my travel plans on it. I do not know which train I had planned to take, so I was thinking of having an announcement made asking about what was written on the paper.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about your train, explaining that you were thinking of asking about the contents of your forgotten travel-plan paper through an announcement. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 個人の旅行内容を放送で尋ねるのではなく、まず行き先を伺えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Rather than asking about your personal travel details over an announcement, could you first tell me where you are going?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 仙台方面です。途中で寄る店や宿の名前まで放送する必要はありません。まず今乗れる列車を調べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 目的方面を伝え店宿の情報を放送せず現在乗れる列車を知りたいと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Toward Sendai. There is no need to announce even the names of the shops or accommodation I plan to visit along the way. First, I would like to find out which train I can take now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State your destination direction and say that you want to know which train you can take now, without announcing shop or accommodation details. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 紙を探すことと、次の列車を調べることは分けられます。紙を最後に見た場所は覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can deal separately with finding the paper and checking the next train. Do you remember where you last saw the paper?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 駅の外の待合スペースです。忘れ物としてそちらを確認しつつ、列車の案内もお願いしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 最後に駅外待合で紙を見たので忘れ物確認と列車案内を分けて頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: In the waiting area outside the station. While checking there for it as a lost item, I would also like some guidance about trains.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you last saw the paper in the waiting area outside the station, and ask separately for a lost-item check and train guidance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 列車は現在の案内で確認できます。旅行予定は同行者にも共有していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can check the trains using current information. Have you also shared your travel plans with anyone traveling with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人に写真を送りました。駅の係に私の予定を再現してもらうのではなく、友人へ写真を送ってもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 共有先友人へ写真再送を頼み係へ予定再現を求めないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I sent a photograph to a friend. Instead of asking station staff to recreate my plans, I will ask my friend to send me the photograph.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you will ask the friend you shared the photograph with to send it again, rather than asking staff to recreate your plans. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それなら、予定が分かった後に今の列車と照合できますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then once you know your plans, you can compare them with the trains currently available.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。写真は元の予定として見て、今の運行案内と同じとは限らないと考えて照合します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 写真の元予定を現在運行と同一とせず照合すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will treat the photograph as my original plan and compare it with current service information, recognizing that they are not necessarily the same.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Answer that you will compare the original plans in the photograph with current train operations rather than assume they match. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 予定の写真はご友人に頼み、列車は現在の案内と照合する形ですね。こちらの仙台方面の表示をご確認ください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: You will ask your friend for the photograph of your plans and compare the train with current information. Please check this display for trains toward Sendai. Thank you for your inquiry.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのようなご用件でしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人が申し込みを考えていて、案内を聞きに来ました。私が申込者ではないので、自分の事情として答えないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人申込の案内を聞く立場で自分が申込者でないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend is considering applying, and I have come to hear the guidance. Since I am not the applicant, I want to avoid answering as though it were about my own circumstances.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you are here to obtain guidance for your friend's application and are not the applicant yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今日は申請書を提出するのではなく、案内を聞くのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: So today you are here for information, not to submit an application form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。提出の代理を頼まれたわけではありません。友人が自分で準備できるよう、必要な案内を持ち帰りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 代理提出依頼でなく本人準備用の案内持帰りと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I was not asked to submit it on my friend's behalf. I would like to take home the necessary guidance so that my friend can prepare independently.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Answer that you were not asked to submit an application as a representative, and are taking home guidance for your friend's own preparation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご本人に確認が必要な事項は、そのようにお伝えできます。友人の状況はどこまでご存じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can indicate which matters need to be confirmed with the applicant. How much do you know about your friend's situation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 転居を予定していることだけです。日付などは知らないので、私の都合の日付で埋めないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 知るのは転居予定のみで日付を自分の都合で補わないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Only that my friend is planning to move. I do not know the date or other details, so I will not fill them in with dates that suit my own schedule.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you only know of the planned move and will not fill in the date according to your own convenience. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、条件と確認事項を分けてメモしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then please make separate notes of the requirements and the items needing confirmation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。必要な書類と、本人が答えるべき項目を分けます。私が全部説明済みだとは伝えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 必要書類と本人回答項目を分け全説明済みとしないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I understand. I will separate the necessary documents from the questions my friend needs to answer personally. I will not say that I have already explained everything.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will distinguish required documents from items the applicant must answer, and will not claim that everything has been explained. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 案内後、友人ご本人から問い合わせることもできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Your friend can also contact us personally after receiving the guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。私のメモだけで申込めると断定せず、不明点は友人から確認してもらいます。今日は案内資料をいただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: メモだけで申込可能と断定せず本人問い合わせを促し資料を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will not say for certain that my friend can apply using only my notes, and will ask my friend to check any unclear points personally. Today I would like to receive the information materials.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Avoid claiming that your notes alone are enough to apply, encourage your friend to contact the office, and request the materials. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 本日はご友人への案内資料のお渡しとして承りました。転居日などはご本人に確認していただき、不明な項目はご本人から相談してください。申請書の提出は受けていません。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Today we have understood your request as receiving guidance materials for your friend. Please have your friend confirm the moving date and other details and consult us personally about unclear items. We have not accepted an application form. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。今日は何についてご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to discuss today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 症状は検査の後からと言いましたが、前にも少しあったかもしれません。はっきりしない順番を決めつけず、先生へ説明したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 症状を検査後と述べたが前にもあったかもしれず順序不明と伝えたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I said that the symptoms started after the test, but I may have had them a little beforehand too. I want to explain this to the doctor without deciding on an uncertain sequence of events.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you previously said the symptoms followed the test, but they may have occurred before it too, and you want to say that the order is unclear. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 時刻や記録の手がかりはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have any clues, such as times or records?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家族へ送ったメッセージがあります。ただ、症状そのものの記録か、別の話かをまだ見直していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家族への記録があるが症状記録か未確認と答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: There is a message I sent to my family. However, I have not yet checked again whether it records those symptoms or is about something else.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Answer that you have a message to your family but have not confirmed whether it is a record of the symptoms. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その記録で分かることと、覚えていることを分けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please distinguish what the record establishes from what you remember.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。メッセージの時刻だけで症状の開始時刻とせず、内容も確認します。今は順番が不確かだと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 時刻だけを発症時刻とせず内容を確認し今は順序不明と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will check the message's contents rather than treating its timestamp alone as the time the symptoms began. For now, I will explain that I am uncertain about the order.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the content rather than equate the timestamp with symptom onset, and explain that the sequence is currently unclear. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 症状が検査によるものかどうかは、先生が状況を伺って判断します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: The doctor will hear about the circumstances and assess whether the symptoms are related to the test.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。後に気付いたから検査が原因だと私が決めず、前にもあった可能性を伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 検査原因と断定せず前にもあった可能性を医師へ話すと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I understand. I will not decide that the test caused them just because I noticed them afterward; I want to mention that they may have been present before as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Answer that you will tell the doctor about the possibility of earlier symptoms without declaring the test to be the cause. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 診察時にそのようにお話しください。メモはお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please explain it that way during your consultation. Do you have any notes?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今、確かなことと不確かなことを分けて書きます。以前の説明を隠さず、順番を訂正したいと先生に話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確実不確実を分けメモし過去説明を隠さず順序訂正を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will now write down what is certain separately from what is uncertain. Without hiding my previous explanation, I will tell the doctor that I would like to correct the sequence of events.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will note definite and uncertain facts separately and openly tell the doctor that you want to correct the sequence in your earlier explanation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 症状が検査の前にもあったかもしれず、順番はまだ不確かというお話ですね。その点を診察の担当へお伝えします。記録を見直したメモも、ご自身でお見せください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: You are saying that the symptoms may have been present before the test too, and their sequence is still uncertain. I will pass that on to the person handling your consultation. Please also show the notes you make after reviewing the record yourself. Thank you for discussing this.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。ご相談を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Please tell me about your concern.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自転車がなくなった件です。知人から映像に誰か写っていたと聞き、私も映像を見たような言い方をしましたが、自分では見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 知人から映像情報を聞いたが自分で見た表現を訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: This is about my missing bicycle. An acquaintance told me that someone appeared in footage, and I spoke as though I had also seen the footage, but I have not seen it myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Correct your statement that implied you had seen footage when you had only heard about it from an acquaintance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: あなたが直接確認したのは、何ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 止めた場所に自転車がないことです。映像に写った人の姿や行動は、知人の話でしか知りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 直接確認は駐輪場所にないことで人物行動は伝聞と答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: That my bicycle was not where I had parked it. I only know about the appearance and actions of the person in the footage through what my acquaintance told me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Answer that you directly verified only that the bicycle was absent from its parking place, while the person's appearance and behavior are secondhand information. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 知人の話は、いつ、どのように聞きましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: When and how did you hear what your acquaintance said?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 昨日電話で聞きました。記録はしていないので、言葉を一字一句覚えているとは言えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 昨日電話の話で録音なく逐語記憶ではないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Over the phone yesterday. I did not record it, so I cannot say that I remember the exact words one by one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you heard it by phone yesterday, did not record it, and cannot recall it word for word. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その区別が必要です。映像そのものを今お持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: That distinction is necessary. Do you have the footage itself with you now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 持っていません。聞いた内容から人物の顔を自分で描いて、映像の代わりとして出すことはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 映像を持たず想像の人物絵を映像の代替にしないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: No, I do not. I will not draw the person's face from what I have heard and submit that as a substitute for the footage.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Answer that you do not have the footage and will not provide an imagined drawing as its replacement. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かりました。ご自身で確認した経過から順に伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I understand. We will first hear the sequence of events that you verified yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。最後に止めた時と、ないことに気付いた時を伝えます。知人から聞いた話は、情報源を明示して別に話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 駐輪と発見の直接経過を示し知人情報は出所付きで分けると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will explain when I last parked it and when I noticed it was gone. I will separately describe what my acquaintance told me and clearly identify the source.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will provide your direct account of parking and discovering the loss, and separately give the acquaintance's information with its source identified. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご自身で見たことと知人から聞いたことを区別して記録します。詳しい日時は担当への説明でお伝えください。受付での確認は以上です。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will record separately what you saw yourself and what you heard from your acquaintance. Please give the precise dates and times when you speak to the staff member handling the matter. That concludes our checks at reception. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのようなお問い合わせですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to ask about?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 不在通知を見て、荷物が届いたと送り主へ連絡しました。でも自分はまだ受け取っていません。通知の意味を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 不在通知で届いたと連絡したが未受取で意味を確認したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: After seeing a missed-delivery notice, I told the sender that the package had arrived. However, I have not received it myself yet. I would like to check what the notice means.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you told the sender it had arrived after seeing a missed-delivery notice, but have not received the parcel and want to confirm the notice's meaning. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 通知に、受け取りの案内は書かれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Does the notice contain instructions for receiving the package?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、再配達について書かれています。家に訪問があったことと、私が荷物を受け取ったことを混同しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 再配達記載があり訪問と本人受取を混同したと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, it says something about redelivery. I confused a visit to my home with my actually receiving the package.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Answer that the notice mentions redelivery and that you confused the delivery visit with your own receipt of the parcel. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 荷物が手元にないなら、受け取り方法を確認しましょう。通知はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: If you do not have the package yet, let's check how to receive it. Do you have the notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらです。送り主には受取済みと言わず、不在通知が来ただけだと訂正します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通知を示し送り主へ不在通知のみと訂正すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here it is. I will correct what I told the sender and say that only a missed-delivery notice arrived, rather than that I have received the parcel.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the notice and say that you will correct the sender's understanding to explain that you only received a missed-delivery notice. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 再配達の希望を確認できます。受け取れる時間はお決まりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can check your redelivery preferences. Have you decided when you can receive it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 明日の午後なら在宅します。通知が来た時刻と同じ時刻を希望しなければならないわけではないですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 明日午後在宅で通知時刻に合わせる必要があるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will be home tomorrow afternoon. I do not have to request the same time as the time the notice was left, do I?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will be home tomorrow afternoon and ask whether the requested time has to match the notice's time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 選べる時間は案内で確認してください。ご希望通りになるかは受付時に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the guidance for the time slots you can choose. We will confirm whether your preferred time is possible when taking the request.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。明日午後の候補を確認して依頼し、実際に受け取ってから受取済みと連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受付で午後候補を確認し実受取後に受取済みと連絡すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I understand. I will check the available options for tomorrow afternoon and request redelivery, then tell the sender that I have received it only after I actually do.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Answer that you will check the afternoon options when booking and report receipt only after actually receiving the parcel. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 今は不在通知が届いた段階で、荷物は未受取と確認できました。送り主にはその状況をお伝えください。明日午後の再配達は、案内の選択肢と受付結果で確かめてからご依頼ください。お問い合わせありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have confirmed that only the missed-delivery notice has arrived so far and that the package has not been received. Please tell the sender that. Before requesting redelivery for tomorrow afternoon, check the options in the guidance and the booking result. Thank you for your inquiry.
